top_categories.workout_context: Epic Gran Canaria's mountainous paved road rewards steady threshold power. Surging and recovering costs more watts than just holding.
Race-pace efforts that mimic Epic Gran Canaria's demands. Pacing, fueling, and tactical decisions under fatigue. Practice the race before February.
At mile 60 of 116, glycogen is gone. This workout teaches your body to produce watts on fumes.

Road-specific control matters at Epic Gran Canaria. Practice on mountainous paved road: use smooth gear and cadence changes, accelerate deliberately out of corners, and settle quickly back into sustainable power for 116 miles.
When someone attacks on mountainous paved road, you have 10 seconds to respond or you're off the back. This builds that response.
At Epic Gran Canaria, changes in grade or pace can lift effort above threshold before it settles again. Over-unders train that transition while you keep riding.
88–92% FTP is where you'll spend the hardest sustained miles of Epic Gran Canaria. Train it until it feels boring.
Every hard session works better with a bigger aerobic base. At 116 miles, base fitness is the difference between racing and surviving.
Long rides with hard efforts mixed in. Simulates what Epic Gran Canaria's mountainous paved road actually does to you.
Varied gradients on mountainous paved road demand climbing versatility. Sit the shallow stuff, stand the steep stuff, switch without thinking.
Brief efforts above sustainable power can come from grade changes, positioning, or closing a gap at Epic Gran Canaria. Train them without letting those efforts derail the longer pacing plan.
2-minute all-out efforts on mountainous paved road. Closing gaps, responding to attacks, sprinting for position. Train the burn.

race_overlay.weather: February in Maspalomas, Gran Canaria, Spain. Rehearse adaptable layers and race-day kit changes in the final 2 weeks before Epic Gran Canaria. Use the organizer's current forecast and safety instructions for final choices.
race_overlay.nutrition: Target 60–80g carbs/hour for Epic Gran Canaria’s 116 miles. Start fueling within the first 30 minutes — early fueling prevents late-race collapse. Bonking at mile 60 is a nutrition failure, not a fitness failure.
race_overlay.altitude: Altitude may change sustainable power and recovery at Epic Gran Canaria. Use conservative pacing and test any travel strategy before the event.
race_overlay.terrain: The course profile at Epic Gran Canaria rewards specific practice. Include regular rides on mountainous paved road to build confidence.

pack_summary: This 10-workout pack focuses on TT Threshold, Race Simulation, and Durability to prepare you for 116 miles of mountainous paved road in Maspalomas, Gran Canaria, Spain.
